<notes>
revised -> both harness.py and prompts/task.md -> base1 divergence: 1/3 base rollouts produced 78 (incorrect); base2 and base3 produced 7 (correct) on deterministic modular arithmetic problem. Library entry holdout-numeric-005 provides direct precedent: identifies code extraction + task instruction as the solution for numeric computational problems. All 6 candidates implement identical changes: add regex extraction of ```python code blocks and tools.python execution in harness.py with fallback to text; add explicit instruction to prompts/task.md requesting Python code. All 6 candidate rollouts delivered correct answer (7) by extracting and executing code blocks generated by LLM in response to instruction. Library evidence shows both components are necessary: extraction without instruction does not trigger code generation; instruction without extraction cannot execute the generated code. This is not overfitting: the pattern is confirmed in 6/6 candidate rollouts and supported by prior task (holdout-numeric-005) on identical problem type.
</notes>
